北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾气浓，体感很冷，注意保暖和交通安全哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy and feels very cold. Stay warm and be safe on the road!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微凉，体感 6℃，别忘了加件外套哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and cool, feeling like 6℃. Don't forget a jacket!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨，体感 4℃ 有些凉，出门记得带伞，小心路滑！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain, feels cool at 4℃. Bring an umbrella and watch for slippery roads!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州有雾，注意出行安全，湿度大体感舒适。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is foggy, drive safely. High humidity makes it feel comfortable.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳雾蒙蒙，注意交通安全。体感 15℃ 比较舒适。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is foggy, stay safe on the road. It feels comfortable at 15℃.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 2℃ 稍冷，出门记得多穿点。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels a bit cold at 2℃. Remember to dress warmly when going out.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京小雨 3℃，体感-3℃ 很湿冷，务必注意保暖！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has light rain at 3℃, feels very cold and damp at -3℃. Dress warmly!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 1℃ 湿度大，出门带伞防不时之需。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels like 1℃ with high humidity. Bring an umbrella for any surprises.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阵雨，体感 0℃ 湿冷，添衣保暖防感冒哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has showers, feels cold and damp at 0℃. Add layers to avoid a cold!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 0℃ 湿度高，注意防潮和保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 0℃ with high humidity. Watch out for dampness and stay warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，外出记得戴口罩，注意呼吸道健康。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has haze, wear a mask when going out and protect your respiratory health.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感-24℃，超级冷！请务必全副武装，注意防寒！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -24℃, extremely cold! Bundle up completely and protect yourself from the cold!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳雾气大，体感-29℃ 极寒，出行注意保暖和安全。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is very foggy and extremely cold at -29℃. Stay warm and safe when going out.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -29℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明天气晴朗，体感 5℃ 稍凉，早晚温差大哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, feels a bit cool at 5℃. Mind the large temperature difference between day and night.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，体感 12℃ 舒适，但注意行车安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy, feels comfortable at 12℃. Please drive safely.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感-6℃ 寒冷，注意防风保暖哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels cold at -6℃. Guard against wind and stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，体感-15℃ 寒风凛冽，务必多穿衣物。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels biting cold at -15℃. Be sure to layer up!
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃
